subject: history
concept: Understanding that alliances between nations can turn a small conflict into a much larger one
source_inspiration: original content, following the Education Conduct Policy's complete-truth principle — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student builds a simple alliance chain with connection cards, seeing how pulling one card affects the whole chain
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a nation to the ally that would be pulled into a conflict alongside it
exercise.abstract: Student explains, in their own words, how alliances can turn a small dispute into a wider war

misconception_flags: believes a world war began for one single simple reason, missing the role of complex alliance networks

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
